latest.title: What patients think of alternative response units
latest.finding: Key experience constructs: convenience of home-based care, avoiding unnecessary ED attendance, perceived competence plus interpersonal communication, reassurance and psychological safety, and perceived longer-term benefit from referral and continuity of care

latest.title: Psychological first aid for paramedic families
latest.finding: Four themes: communicating with care and confidence, navigating the 'not normal', creating an open culture, and sustaining support beyond the programme; participants reported better work-to-home transitions and stronger family and peer relationships
